culprit_citations.quoted_text: Equipment Financing | May 28, 2024 | May 1, 2026 | Fixed interest rate 16.0%; EOT 0.0% | 215 | 215 | 218

findings.detail: The completeness denominator treats structural blank and row-spanned HTML cells as investment leaves, although the investment row has fair value 218 in the Fair Value column.

rationale: Class 3 anchor triangulation rejects the 43.4% leaf-cell coverage metric as a measure of position fair-value completeness. The filing reports total investments of 2,483.554 million, while the extracted fund-quarter fair value is 2,475.678 million, or 99.68% of the schedule total. Raw table 13 uses a 23-cell HTML layout with intentionally blank continuation, spacer, currency, and row-spanned cells; row 6 still contains fair value 218 in the Fair Value column despite blank issuer and currency cells. Thus the flag is caused by an overbroad structural-leaf denominator, not evidence that 56.6% of investment positions lack fair value. The remaining 7.876 million difference is small but is not localized by this evidence and remains residual risk outside the B01 flag mechanism.
